fill_rule: For every closed experiment in the ExperimentRegistry, load the sealed TelemetryRecord referenced by its optimization_telemetry StageRef (StageRef.sha256 must equal the record's frozen_sha256()). Emit one point per experiment: x = pre.surrogate_mean_detection_rate, y = mean of outcome.heldout_detection_rates (sorted model ids), color by outcome.verdict. Skip records with outcome == null. The 45-degree identity line and the x = surrogate / y = held-out quadrant are drawn by the renderer, not stored.
title: Surrogate-vs-held-out transfer scatter across closed generations
